## Download and run

1. Download **OpenTeslaBuyer-…-win-x64.zip** below and unzip it.
2. Run **OpenTeslaBuyer.exe**. Nothing needs installing: .NET is included. Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit.
3. Windows SmartScreen may say it "protected your PC" because the app isn't code-signed yet: choose **More info › Run anyway**.

No car nearby? Pick a simulator as the source on the Diagnostics page.

## What you need for a real car

A CAN adapter (OBDLink MX+/EX, an ELM327, or a CANable) and the harness for your car's diagnostic connector. See
[Hardware](https://github.com/ErikHakobyan/OpenTeslaBuyer#hardware) in the README.

The tool **only listens** to the car; it never sends anything to it.

## Preview

Version 0.x is built from community reverse engineering and simulators and hasn't been verified on many cars yet.
If you try it, please [tell us how it went](https://github.com/ErikHakobyan/OpenTeslaBuyer/issues/new/choose),
including what looked wrong. That is the most useful contribution there is right now.
